estimates.assumptions: A 'dash' of oil for searing in a large casserole is estimated at 1 tbsp (15ml/g) based on typical recipe usage for browning meat; calories copied from known value.
2 tsp cumin seeds/powder weighs ~4g (2g per tsp); calories copied from known value for cumin.
1 large cinnamon stick estimated at ~3g (typical dried bark weight); calories copied from known value for cinnamon.
3 bay leaves estimated at ~2g total (0.5-1g per large dried leaf); calories copied from known value for bay leaves.

2 ancho chillies (dried poblano peppers) estimated at ~15g each based on typical whole dried chile weights; calories estimated from standard dried chile pepper data (~282 kcal/100g) as no known value supplied.

2 x 400g tins of borlotti beans: standard drained/edible weight is ~240g per 400g tin (accounting for brine); total 480g. Calories from standard drained/canned borlotti/cranberry bean values (~138 kcal/100g) as no known value supplied.
